title: Stoke Space header
description: A sticky header. On phones a full-width 76px frosted bar with the wordmark and a thin plus that glows in the primary colour and opens a full-height menu (the plus turns to a cross while a clip-path wipes the panel down). From 1024px a centred frosted pill with square-ish 4px corners floats in a transparent strip; links turn the primary colour on hover and can drop down sub-links.
notes: sticky: put it first inside the page wrapper; the first section sits right below it (76px phones, 126px desktop)
the frosted pill only reads as a panel over media; on a plain page it is a faint 5% tint
needs JavaScript for the phone menu
